about: Excerpts of Kumbia Kombat music for the tillandsias audio.detect_glitches fixture (2078-kmbx). 48 kHz stereo, FLAC 24-bit, 96000 frames each. wrap = the source's last 48000 samples then its first 48000, so the loop point is at 1.000 s; 't +-1 s' = 1 s either side of t. Expectations are the v2 detector (tool_version 2, SEAM_FACTOR 2.0) on the whole source; re-check at 1.5.
provenance: Own renders: ACE-Step 1.5 XL turbo (acestep_v1.5_xl_turbo_bf16.safetensors, Comfy-Org/ACE-Step-1.5 rev 371bb1680f8c, Apache-2.0) in ComfyUI v0.40.0 via studio.run_workflow (pipeline 56.11.6.2); parents 2026-11-07/08, layered tiers 2026-11-09 (audio.transform), game mix mixrs 2026-11-10.
